name: Maverick Boost - Supply
desc: When this card is activated: You can add to your hand 1 "Maverick Hunter" or "Maverick Boost" card from your Deck to your hand. You can return 1 card you control except "Maverick Boost - Supply" to your hand, add to your hand 1 "Maverick Analyzer" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Boost - Supply" once per turn.
